target_rule: Switch to the other allocator relative to the actually retained parent at each round. A rejected first round does not turn the next task into a no-op.
feedback: Only prior acceptance, stage booleans and required/resolved configuration checks; no raw guest captures, numeric runtime observations, paper or credentials.
acceptance: Accept only a native-valid candidate passing the existing build, three fresh original-suite guest executions, resolved requirements, preservation checks and the round decision deadline. Otherwise retain the previous image and configuration, and verify that image in fresh guests.
completion_boundary: Round observation includes generation, transfer, build, three guest validations and any rejected-candidate recovery checks. The decision deadline is 1800 s; history accounting includes both rounds and recovery but excludes initial-parent checks and offline audit.
interpretation: Prescribed state-linked configuration changes evaluated with frozen original tests. KVM guests exit between invocations; this is build-and-reboot configuration lineage, not in-place hot update, an optimizer, held-out workload certification or RSI. Initial/recovery boots are state checks, not extra candidate replications.
change: Budget sensitivity only: 1152 aggregate output tokens per round and 288 per graph objective/path stage. Prompts, graph, threshold, utility selection, task, parent rule, feedback, acceptance and rollback are unchanged. Source-location bindings are isolated and recorded.
external_validation: registry/tenonos_scale_validation_rpi4_v1.json is frozen before this batch. Do not expose its outputs in generation, feedback, selection or retries; validate retained configurations separately after collection.
authorization: User explicitly permits reasonable subsequent API experiments toward the goal. This batch is bounded to 24 calls and 13824 output tokens, transmitting only frozen tasks, public metadata/graph fragments and the permitted configuration-check feedback.
